message: Do not bother players with high score file errors
bug: IOException swallowed by an empty catch: a failed save is lost silently

message: Read the pause key by name
bug: Strings compared with ==: getKeyText returns a new string, so P never pauses

message: Trace frames while tuning the renderer
bug: Debug printing on every frame, sixty times a second

message: Simplify the extra life check
bug: An extra life only when the score lands exactly on a multiple of 10,000; passing it (9,990 to 10,040) gives none (rule 7)

message: Make stuns shorter on later levels
bug: The 2-second floor is gone: from level 6 a flare stuns for 0 or a negative time (rule 10)

message: Let the edges wrap like the tunnel
bug: Every row now wraps, so the outer walls on other rows lead through to the far side (rule 13: row 7 only)

message: Compare tiles instead of distances
bug: Collision by tile: two centres 0.1 apart across a tile edge do not meet, and 0.9 apart in one tile do (rule 11)

message: Reset the frame timer after each update
bug: The time left over after the steps is thrown away, so the game runs slower than real time (rule 2)

message: Reward chaining stuns
bug: Stun points now double (100, 200, 400) like classic arcade games; the spec says 100 for each shade, never doubling (rule 6)

message: Dim the lantern faster for more tension
bug: The light shrinks every 10 seconds; the spec says every 20 (rule 9)

message: Let players resize the window
bug: The window can be resized; the spec says fixed size (rule 1)

message: Use the whole screen for a bigger maze
bug: The window is maximised to the whole screen; the spec says half the screen, never maximised (rule 1)

message: Lower CPU use: update at 30 fps
bug: Logic now steps at 1/30 s; the spec says fixed steps of 1/60 s (rule 2)

message: Pixel-perfect 16 px tiles
bug: Tiles are a fixed 16 px instead of scaling to the window (rule 3)

message: Always keep the last game's score
bug: The high score file is overwritten by every game, even a worse one (rule 14: only when beaten)

message: Check tile centres exactly
bug: Exact float equality: after a few steps positions drift (9.500000000000002), so turns and pickups are missed

message: Simplify the distance comparison
bug: Ties now go to the last direction checked (Right before Up); the spec says ties go Up, Left, Down, Right (rule 12)

message: Keep the lantern and stun clocks running smoothly
bug: The lantern and stun clocks now run while paused, so pausing dims the light and ends stuns (rule 5)

message: Drop a stale turn sooner when blocked
bug: The turn buffer is counted down twice per step while the player waits at a wall, so an early turn is forgotten after 4 steps (rule 4: 8)

message: Add M to mute
bug: New feature that follows the spec; anything reported is a false alarm

message: Say when the high score cannot be saved
bug: Fixes the empty catch from the high score commit

message: Name the player's tile in the renderer
bug: No behaviour change; anything reported is a false alarm
